english: Chen Wu relayed another message: "You unfilial wretch!
chinese: '陳舞復傳語云：'不孝那！

english: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear."
chinese: 父母至親，實不相疑，事理如此，實為見誣，想眾人見明也。」

english: The crown prince had been deposed through no fault of his own, and people were indignant and resentful.
chinese: 太子既廢非其罪，眾情憤怨。

english: Right Guard Commandant Sima Ya, a distant kinsman of the imperial house, and Attendant Commandant Xu Chao, both favorites of the crown prince, grieved deeply; they told Sun Xiu, stratagemist to Lun, Prince of Zhao: "The state has no true heir—altar and grain will be imperiled; great ministers' disaster is sure to rise.
chinese: 右衛督司馬雅，宗室之疏屬也，與常從督許超並有寵于太子，二人深傷之，說趙王倫謀臣孫秀曰：「國無適嗣，社稷將危，大臣之禍必起。

english: Why not plot first!"
chinese: 何不先謀之！」

english: Sun Xiu relayed the plan to Lun, the Prince of Zhao, and Lun wholeheartedly accepted it.
chinese: 秀言于趙王倫，倫深納焉。

english: With the plan set, Xiu said to Lun, "The crown prince is by nature rigid and fierce; if he gains his will he will certainly give free rein to his temper.
chinese: 計既定，而秀說倫曰：「太子為人剛猛，若得志之日，必肆其情性矣。

english: Better delay: Empress Jia is sure to harm the crown prince; then depose Jia, avenge the crown prince—merit enough to win your will."
chinese: 不若遷延卻期，賈后必害太子，然後廢賈后，為太子報仇，猶足以為功，乃可以得志。」

english: Lun assented.
chinese: 倫然之。

english: Sun Xiu then had disinformation circulated, claiming that men in the palace wished to depose Empress Jia and bring the crown prince back.
chinese: 秀因使反間，言殿中人欲廢賈后，迎太子。

english: When Empress Jia heard this, she became anxious and afraid. She ordered Cheng Ju, the chief court physician, to compound pills from croton and apricot kernels.
chinese: 賈后聞之憂怖，乃使太醫令程據合巴豆杏子丸。

english: In the third month, she forged an edict and sent the Yellow Gate attendant Sun Lü to carry the pills to Xuchang and kill the crown prince.
chinese: 三月，矯詔使黃門孫慮齋至許昌以害太子。

english: Earlier, fearing that he would be poisoned, the crown prince always cooked his own food in front of himself.
chinese: 初，太子恐見鴆，恆自煮食於前。

english: Lü reported this to Liu Zhen, who moved the crown prince to a small compound and denied him food. Palace personnel still passed food to him over the walls.
chinese: 慮以告劉振，振乃徙太子于小坊中，絕不與食，宮中猶於牆壁上過食與太子。

english: Sun Lü then tried to force the medicine on the crown prince, but he refused to take it. When the crown prince went to the privy, Lü beat him to death with a medicine pestle. The crown prince cried out loudly, and his cries could be heard outside.
chinese: 慮乃逼太子以藥，太子不肯服，因如廁，慮以藥杵椎殺之，太子大呼，聲聞於外。

english: He was then twenty-three.
chinese: 時年二十三。

english: They proposed burying him by commoner rites; Empress Jia memorialized: "Yu has unfortunately died—I mourn his confusion and error and early cutting-off; grief overwhelms me.
chinese: 將以庶人禮葬之，賈后表曰：「遹不幸喪亡，傷其迷悖，又早短折，悲痛之懷，不能自己。

english: Your servant is dull and shallow, ignorant of ritual propriety, overwhelmed by utmost feeling—rashly venturing to memorialize."
chinese: 妾誠暗淺不識禮義，不勝至情，冒昧陳聞。」

english: An edict buried him with rites due the Prince of Guangling.
chinese: 詔以廣陵王禮葬之。

english: When Deposed Commoner Jia died, they executed Liu Zhen, Sun Lü, Cheng Ju, and others, and posthumously restored the crown prince; the edict read: "The emperor dispatches the credential-bearer, concurrent Director of Works, Commandant of the Guard Yi to announce by patent to the spirit of the late crown prince: Alas!
chinese: 及賈庶人死，乃誅劉振、孫慮、程據等，冊復太子曰：「皇帝使使持節、兼司空、衛尉伊策故皇太子之靈曰：嗚呼！

english: If soul possesses awareness may it receive this heart."
chinese: 魂而有靈，尚獲爾心。」

english: The emperor wore unhemmed mourning for the crown prince as for an eldest son; the ministers wore hemmed mourning. He sent Minister He Yu to lead the Eastern Palace officials in preparing the prescribed auspicious and mourning rites and bringing the crown prince's bier back from Xuchang.
chinese: 帝為太子服長子斬衰，群臣齊衰，使尚書和郁率東宮官屬具吉凶之制，迎太子喪于許昌。

english: When the hearse set out, great wind and thunder came—canopies and coverings flew torn.
chinese: 喪之發也，大風雷電，幃蓋飛裂。

english: They further composed a condolence text: "The emperor facing the gallery sends Groom of the Household Liu Wu to the crown prince's lying-in-state: Ah, Yu!
chinese: 又為哀策曰：「皇帝臨軒，使洗馬劉務告于皇太子之殯曰：咨爾遹！

english: May light reach posterity, never extinguished through ages."
chinese: 庶光來葉，永世不泯。」

english: Canonized Crown Prince Minhuai.
chinese: 諡曰湣懷。

english: On jimao day of the sixth month he was buried at Xianping Mausoleum.
chinese: 六月己卯，葬于顯平陵。

english: Moved by Yan Zuan's words the emperor raised a Terrace of Longing for Sons; former ministers Jiang Tong and Lu Ji both composed dirges.
chinese: 帝感閻纘之言，立思子台，故臣江統、陸機並作誄頌焉。

english: The crown prince had three sons—Bin, Zang, and Shang—all imprisoned with their father at Jinyong.
chinese: 太子三子：虨、臧、尚，並與父同幽金墉。

english: Bin, courtesy name Daowen, died in the first month of Yongkang year one.
chinese: 虨字道文，永康元年正月，薨。

english: In the fourth month he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang.
chinese: 四月，追封南陽王。

english: Second son Zang, styled Jingwen.
chinese: 臧字敬文。

english: In the fourth month of Yongkang year one he was enfeoffed Prince of Linhuai.
chinese: 永康元年四月，封臨淮王。

english: On jisi day an edict stated: "Ill omens pile; crafty factions stir; Yu was driven from office and died unnaturally.
chinese: 己巳，詔曰：「咎征數發，奸回作變，遹既逼廢，非命而沒。

english: Lun, Prince of Zhao, acted Grand Tutor to the imperial grandson-heir."
chinese: 趙王倫行太孫太傅。」

english: In the fifth month Lun and the grand heir went together to the Eastern Palace; the grand heir exited the Western Side Gate—carriages, dress, and attendants all followed Minhuai's old train.
chinese: 五月，倫與太孫俱之東宮，太孫自西掖門出，車服侍從皆湣懷之舊也。

english: Reaching Bronze Camel Avenue palace women wept; attendants choked; passersby wiped tears.
chinese: 到銅駝街，宮人哭，侍從者皆哽咽，路人抆淚焉。

english: The mulberry sprouted again west of the wing; when the grand heir was deposed it withered.
chinese: 桑復生於西廂，太孫廢，乃枯。

english: In the first month of Yongning year one Lun, Prince of Zhao, usurped the throne and demoted Zang to Prince of Puyang. Zang moved with the emperor to Jinyong and was murdered soon afterward.
chinese: 永甯元年正月，趙王倫篡位，廢為濮陽王，與帝俱遷金墉，尋被害。

english: Early in Tai'an the posthumous title Ai was granted.
chinese: 太安初，追諡曰哀。

english: Shang, styled Jingren.
chinese: 尚字敬仁。

english: In Yongkang fourth month he was made Prince of Xiangyang.
chinese: 永康元年四月，封為襄陽王。

english: In Yongning eighth month he was made imperial grandson-heir.
chinese: 永寧元年八月，立為皇太孫。

english: On guimao in Tai'an third month he died; the emperor wore trimmed mourning for a year and granted the posthumous title Chong Imperial Grandson.
chinese: 太安元年三月癸卯，薨，帝服齊衰期，諡曰沖太孫。

english: The historiographers say: Minhuai was endowed with exceptional wisdom and displayed precocious gifts.
chinese: 史臣曰：湣懷挺岐嶷之姿，表夙成之質。

english: Emperor Wu cherished him and deeply laid succession plans.
chinese: 武皇鍾愛，既深詒厥之謀；

english: All under Heaven turned hearts toward him—high hopes attended his future.
chinese: 天下歸心，頗有後來之望。

english: When the new ruler ascended the imperial throne and the prince guarded the succession in the Eastern Palace, he neglected the four teachings and sometimes omitted the three daily greetings. His leopard’s form was not yet transformed, while his phoenix virtue had already declined. He trusted wicked deceivers and drove away upright men, enjoyed the lowly work of butchering and selling wine, and indulged in idle outings in the parks. Truly one may say: "All have a beginning, but few carry through to the end."
chinese: 及於繼明宸極，守器春坊，四教不勤，三朝或闕，豹姿未變，鳳德已衰，信惑奸邪，疏斥正士，好屠酤之賤役，耽苑囿之佚遊，可謂靡不有初，鮮克有終者也。

english: Thereupon the inner palace proved fierce and cruel, long harboring murderous intent; outer kin flattered, competing to advance slander.
chinese: 既而中宮凶忍，久懷危害之心，外戚諂諛，競進讒邪之說；

english: The plot involving a sacrificial victim had already been laid; the slander involving a dead dog then took effect.
chinese: 坎牲之謀已構，斃犬之譖遂行；

english: The ruler lacked the discernment to uncover hidden matters, and the ministers lacked the integrity to remonstrate.
chinese: 一人乏探隱之聰，百辟無爭臣之節。

english: Thus the injustice exceeded that done to Jian of Chu, and the cruelty surpassed the tragedy commemorated at Li Garden.
chinese: 遂使冤逾楚建，酷甚戾園。

english: Though mourning rites ran full and grief ran deep, what did they mend for the poisoned innocent!
chinese: 雖復禮備哀榮，情深憫慟，亦何補於荼毒者哉！

english: The encomium says: Minhuai was intelligent and perceptive, truly endowed by Heaven.
chinese: 贊曰：湣懷聰穎，諒惟天挺。

english: His imperial grandfather cherished him deeply; the assembled officials looked forward in expectation.
chinese: 皇祖鐘心，庶僚引領。

english: When he first entered the heir’s palace, his princely virtue failed to grow.
chinese: 震宮肇建，儲德不恢。

english: Gathering wasps opened a breach; sending back sacrificial meat brought disaster.
chinese: 掇蜂構隙，歸胙生災。

english: Once brutal cruelty struck, vain hope alone remained of return.
chinese: 既罹凶忍，徒望歸來。
